# Common questions

## How much does a website cost?

Packages start at SCR 7,500 for Foundation, SCR 12,500 for Starter and SCR 25,000 for Growth. Custom work is scoped separately. The written proposal confirms the final price.

## What is included in the price?

The package lists the included page range, design, responsive development, contact options, SEO foundations, revisions and post-launch support. The written scope records any project-specific additions or exclusions.

## How long does a project take?

Many standard projects take around 3 to 6 weeks. Scope, content readiness, feedback and integrations can change the timeline, so the proposal includes a project-specific estimate.

## Do I own the website and domain?

The final approved website files and assets transfer as agreed when the project closes. The domain remains in the client's registrar account. Third-party licences and services remain subject to their own terms.

## Can I update the website myself?

Content management is included in Starter and Growth for agreed fields, can be added to Foundation, and can be scoped for Custom projects. Horizon Digital can also handle later updates.

## Is support included after launch?

Foundation includes 30 days, Starter 45 days and Growth 60 days of post-launch support. Custom support is defined in the proposal.

## Can you guarantee Google rankings or business results?

No. Horizon Digital provides technical and on-page SEO foundations and builds clear contact paths, but search rankings, traffic, enquiries, bookings and revenue depend on factors outside the website build and are not guaranteed.

## How do I get started?

Use the contact page or WhatsApp link to share your business, goals, current website, preferred timeline and approximate budget. Horizon Digital aims to reply within 24 hours.
